model: Economic engine: Core Scientific converted mining sites into colocation, earning rent on billing MW under long leases. Tenants: CoreWeave 590 MW; AMD 377 MW direct plus 152 MW supported neocloud, 15 years, about $14bn, with rights on up to 2 GW more. Costs: power, operations, depreciation, interest. Funding: $3.30bn 7.75% secured notes due 2031; project bonds planned for about $6bn AMD build at $11mn-$12mn per MW. Sensitivities: CoreWeave credit, delivery, spreads, labor. Would break the model: CoreWeave default, AMD build unfunded, reservations unused. Sources: 2Q26 release, call, Needham via Yahoo.
